messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] High error rate observed on /v1/generate from redwood-hosted-us-east (threshold triggered: 5m error rate > 4%). Paging matt (oncall) :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Incident severity: SEV2. Potential customer impact: increased 5xx and latency spikes. Runbook: /runbooks/cache-miss.
matt (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs and timelines now. starting triage in thread.
sara (sre): I'm watching metrics. I see a sudden drop in prefix cache hit-rate ~2069003600. Linking grafana: https://grafana.company/g/redwood/cache-hit?from=2069002000&to=2069004600
priya (eng-runtime): throwing up a quick hypothesis: recent rollout of cache-invalidation job at 2069003400 could have aggressively invalidated prefix index. If so, KV reuse would tank and we'd see rewarm traffic.
dan (customer-ops): any customer-facing incidents? I see a handful of client errors reported by the dashboard (support tickets). tagging @support to verify impact.
alice (prod-analytics): confirmed: top 3 affected orgs show elevated error rates and >2x latency for generation calls between 2069003600-2069004200.
matt (oncall): ok let's build a timeline. I have control-plane deploy events:
```
2069003200 - infra: minor deploy (no cache changes)
2069003400 - jobs: prefix-invalidator v2 scheduled (cron)
2069003500 - runtime: canary rollout of kernel-opt (no cache touch)
2069003600 - metrics: prefix hit-rate drops ~40% in 10m
2069003800 - traffic: rewarm CPU on inference nodes increases
2069004200 - mitigation: paused invalidator job (manual)
2069004400 - hit-rate begins to recover
```
priya (eng-runtime): sharing logs from node pool a1 (snip):
```
[2069003612] cache: prefix_lookup miss key=usr:profile:abc123
[2069003612] kv: fallback to origin, initiating load
[2069003615] cache: rewarm queued for prefix usr:profile:abc123 size=6
[2069003628] eviction: triggered by invalidation job id=inv-2069003400
```
sara (sre): I pulled KV metrics. Reuse rate dropped from 78% -> 26% across pools. Eviction throughput spiked concurrently. attaching short CSV: (will paste link).
ops-bot: log-shared: https://logs.company/streams/2069003600-2069004300 (redacted)
matt (oncall): mitigation attempt 1: increased cache worker concurrency to speed rewarms at 2069003700 — limited effect.
priya (eng-runtime): mitigation attempt 2: paused invalidation job at 2069004200; then we started gradual rewarm throttle to avoid thundering herd.
dan (customer-ops): customers updated: status page posted at 2069004250 saying "degraded performance for generation API in us-east, mitigation underway."
alice (prod-analytics): impact window estimate: 2069003600 - 2069004400. Peak customer error rate at 2069003750. Estimated affected percentage: ~1.8% of requests, skewed to heavy-prefix tenants.
sara (sre): hypothesis list: 1) invalidator job had bug that invalidated too broadly (e.g., wildcard prefix). 2) invalidator triggered evictions before grace TTL expired causing stale prefix rechecks. 3) concurrency/config mismatch: invalidator and rewarm limited, causing cascade.
matt (oncall): next steps while hot: preserve logs, snapshot cache state, pin config of invalidator, and start RCA doc. who's taking lead on RCA?
priya (eng-runtime): i'll take lead. will collect more detailed KV traces (shard-level) and correlate with rollout artifacts.
sara (sre): i'll work on mitigation playbook edits and add a quick check to detect runaway invalidation counts.
alice (prod-analytics): i'll produce final impact numbers and tenant list for outreach.
dan (customer-ops): i'll draft customer comms and coordinate with Support to reach top affected tenants.
matt (oncall): thanks. small note: we saw one pod hit OOM while rewarming at 2069003710 — adding as potential contributor.
priya (eng-runtime): noted. adding OOM trace to ticket. linking PRs for rollback and invalidator fix: https://git.company/repo/pull/2345 (draft).
ops-bot: incident-timer: 00:42:36 since page.
matt (oncall): save this thread as the in-incident RCA coordination thread. when you post artifacts, include timestamps and short description. prefer paste logs to the secure bucket.
sara (sre): quick blocking ask: add metric alerts for sudden prefix hit-rate deltas > 15% in 5m in us-east. creating alert in grafana now.
priya (eng-runtime): prescripted mitigation idea for follow-up: introduce staged invalidation (mark, rewarm, then evict), and limit invalidation rate per shard to reduce cascade. will prototype.
alice (prod-analytics): tagging follow-up task: analysis of cache warmup latency distribution and correlation with kernel-rollout on 2069003500.
dan (customer-ops): support: reporting back — one major customer opened a ticket but did not experience data loss, only latency/errors; they accepted status updates.
matt (oncall): closing the live triage. we'll reconvene for RCA doc tomorrow 09:30 PT. leave this thread as canonical timeline. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
